Bill.BriefDescription: Providing incentives for the purchase of hybrid and fuel cell vehicles.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing incentives for the purchase of hybridand fuel cell vehicles; amending RCW 82.08.020; adding a new section tochapter 82.08 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that improving our airquality is an important goal, and that a major factor affecting our airquality is emissions from older internal combustion engines. Newtechnologies either currently in use or due to come to market in thenear future promise to drastically reduce vehicle emissions. Thelegislature finds that an appropriate goal would be for fifty percentof the motor vehicles sold to be hybrid and fuel cell vehicles by theyear 2013. In order to encourage the citizens of Washington to pursuethis goal through market incentives, the legislature shall reduce salestax on these vehicles, and dedicate the remaining portion of the statesales tax to provide for other transportation alternatives.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The definitions in this section apply throughout this chapterunless the context clearly requires otherwise. (1) "Fuel cell motor vehicle" means a motor vehicle powered by anelectrochemical engine that converts the chemical energy of a fuel,such as hydrogen, and an oxidant, such as oxygen, directly intoelectricity. (2) "Hybrid motor vehicle" means a motor vehicle that usespropulsion units powered by both electricity and gasoline.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 82.08.020 and 2000 2nd sp.s. c 4 s 1 are each amendedto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) There is levied and there shall be collected a tax on eachretail sale in this state. (b) The tax is equal to three and twotenths percent of the sellingprice for sales of hybrid motor vehicles and fuel cell motor vehicles.Revenue collected under this subsection (1)(b) must be deposited in themultimodal transportation account created in RCW 47.66.070. (c) The tax is equal to six and fivetenths percent of the sellingprice for other sales. (2) There is levied and there shall be collected an additional taxon each retail car rental, regardless of whether the vehicle islicensed in this state, equal to five and ninetenths percent of theselling price. The revenue collected under this subsection shall bedeposited in the multimodal transportation account created in RCW47.66.070. (3) The taxes imposed under this chapter shall apply to successiveretail sales of the same property. (4) The rates provided in this section apply to taxes imposed underchapter 82.12 RCW as provided in RCW 82.12.020.
